claim_text: Q3 2025 depreciation and amortization $17.7M, +303% YoY from $4.4M due to Zava acquisition intangibles

evidence.text: Depreciation and amortization was $17.7 million for three months ended September 30, 2025 compared to $4.4 million for three months ended September 30, 2024.

claim_text: Management expects gross margin to stabilize long-term through scale and cost optimization despite current compression

evidence.text: Over the long term we expect gross margin to stabilize as we continue to scale our business and increase our ability to negotiate and optimize more favorable costs of revenue.

claim_text: Management expects marketing expenses as % of revenue to decline long-term via subscriber maturation

evidence.text: With the additional marketing leverage driven by our newer offerings, along with the maturation of our existing Subscriber base, we expect total marketing expenses as a percentage of revenue to continue to decrease over the long term.

claim_text: Personalized offerings expected to increasingly drive Online Revenue growth as subscriber penetration rises

evidence.text: As we expect the percentage of Subscribers on our platform using a personalized solution to continue to increase, we expect revenue from personalized offerings across the business to increasingly drive Online Revenue growth in the future.

claim_text: Management plans to fulfill significant majority of orders through affiliated / wholly-owned pharmacies

evidence.text: We intend to continue to invest in our fulfillment, distribution, and operating capabilities, including in our Affiliated Pharmacy and wholly-owned pharmacies, with the goal of fulfilling a significant majority of our pharmaceutical and over-the-counter customer orders through affiliated and internal fulfillment capabilities.

claim_text: 9M 2025 interest income $19.7M vs 9M 2024's $7.6M driven by higher cash/investment balances

evidence.text: Interest income for the nine months ended September 30, 2025 of $19.7 million, compared to $7.6 million for the nine months ended September 30, 2024. The increases in interest income were driven by the significant balances of cash and cash equivalents and investments during the current year.

claim_text: 9M 2025 inventory increased $40.1M to support customer demand and business growth

evidence.text: The increase in inventory was due to investment to help ensure we can continue meeting customer demand for our offerings, as well as investment related to our overall business growth.
